neighbours.label: the token ' cart' (and ' car' for vehicles), e.g. a shopping cart or railway car
fire: At the supermarket she filled her cart with fruit and bread.
Leave the shopping cart in the bay when you are done.
Each railway car was painted dark green in the factory.
He pushed the cart full of groceries across the parking lot.
The old dining car was turned into a small cafe.
Please add the item to your cart before checking out.
The farmer loaded hay onto the cart behind the horse.
A freight car broke loose and rolled down the hill.
quiet: At the supermarket she filled her basket with fruit and bread.
Leave the shopping basket in the bay when you are done.
Each railway wagon was painted dark green in the factory.
He carried the bags full of groceries across the parking lot.
The old dining hall was turned into a small cafe.
Please add the item to your order before checking out.
The farmer loaded hay onto the wagon behind the horse.
A freight wagon broke loose and rolled down the hill.
